newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan June Btp future to trade in lots of 200 mln.
newsitem.headline: Milan June Btp future to trade in lots of 200 mln.

text.p: The June Btp future will from Monday be traded in lots of 200 on the Milan futures market (MIF) as on the London Liffe market, the Italian bond and futures market management committee said.
Up to now Btp futures on MIF have been traded in lots of 250 million. The March contract will continue to trade in lots of 250 million until its expiry.

Bond dealers said the aim was to put the Milan futures market in line with London. A ministerial decree to this effect and regarding all successive futures contracts was signed today by the Treasury Ministry.
